title: StageExitedData
description: Data of the stage.exited event: the task in the envelope closed its current stage by an exit and took a transition.

kind.description: Kind of the exit: artifact — an artifact of the task, result — the result of an event, negative — a negative result with where it was looked for.

artifact.description: Name of the artifact of an exit of kind artifact.

reason.description: Why the transition was taken; absent if not given.

returns.description: Which return by the transition this is, for a return.

finished.description: The scenario of the task is passed.

source.description: Who did it: operator or agent.
